findings.summary: DOGE actions between Jan 20-Feb 25 2025 created potential investment opportunities in deregulated sectors

DOGE targeted agencies where Musk has a direct business interest in over 70% of cases (Public Citizen analysis). Sectors being deregulated: healthcare, finance, energy, digital assets/crypto, environmental regulation. Formation of three venture capital fund shells (RPV I/II/III) during this exact period raises questions about whether the funds were positioned to invest in sectors benefiting from DOGE deregulation. The I/II/III structure is standard VC vintage-year fund architecture. No investments are publicly documented yet.

NYT investigation (Feb 27, 2026) identified Red Planet Ventures I LLC as one of 15+ Musk entities sharing PO Box 341886 in Austin suburbs. Investigation confirmed ~90 Texas companies in Musk personal network. The three Red Planet Ventures LLCs (I, II, III) were formed by Jared Birchall in late February 2025. Multiple secondary sources (opentools.ai, dnyuz.com, San Antonio Express-News Facebook) confirmed Birchall formation and Twitter acquisition structure parallel. No source identified the fund's purpose, investors, capital, or investments.

Delaware and Nevada registration check for Red Planet Ventures: Web search for 'Red Planet Ventures Delaware OR Nevada registration OR formation' returned no results pointing to any DE or NV entity. SEC EDGAR company browser (queried via search tool) returns zero hits for 'Red Planet Ventures' as an EDGAR filer. EDGAR full-text search (EFTS) also returned zero results for the name. No Delaware or Nevada incorporation found for any Red Planet Ventures variant associated with Musk. Entities confirmed as Texas-only domicile.

Multiple secondary sources reference that the three-entity Red Planet Ventures structure 'mirrors' the LLC architecture Musk used in the Twitter/X acquisition. That acquisition used a similar multi-entity structure (X Holdings I, X Holdings II, X Holdings Corp at close). This is consistent with GP/LP/carry investment fund architecture where: Entity I = General Partner managing entity, Entity II = main LP fund vehicle, Entity III = carried interest or co-invest vehicle. Structure is pre-operational — no investors, no capital, no investments disclosed 13 months after formation.

SYNTHESIS: Red Planet Ventures I/II/III are dormant shelf LLCs — Musk/Birchall fund architecture created during DOGE tenure with zero activity in 13 months. Formed Feb 25 2025 (same day as X.AI Corp Form D — Birchall batch admin day). Triple GP/LP/carry structure at PO Box 341886 (Excession family office). No SEC Form D, no GLEIF LEI, no officers beyond Birchall, no amendments, no litigation, no news coverage beyond NYT Feb 2026 investigation, domain parked. 21 sources probed: zero hits outside TX registry. Investigative significance: entities were created with investment fund architecture during Musk government service but never activated — either (a) parked for future use post-DOGE, (b) abandoned, or (c) operating without required SEC filings. The absence of Form D 13 months post-formation, while Birchall simultaneously filed Form D for X.AI Corp on the same day, suggests deliberate non-filing or no capital deployment.
